the chitosan and chitosan nanoparticles were effective as a denture cleansing agent.

chitosan solutions were effective in controlling biofilm formation on both acrylic resin and Co Cr alloy, with effervescent tablets being most effective against all microorganisms and the chitosan solutions being more effective than water alone.
